note: PROVISIONAL card claiming the next free id (17) for firmware repo IEEE-BLP-SHT40; gateway/cards/ previously only went up to id 16. Field layout (temperature_c, humidity_pct; int16/uint16 LE, scale 0.01 each) mirrors 02_bme688.json's first two measurands, which use the same encoding for the same physical quantities. Conversion formulas (T = -45 + 175*raw/65535, RH = -6 + 125*raw/65535, clamped to 0-100) are the Sensirion SHT4x datasheet's standard formulas and are NOT yet confirmed against real hardware -- confirm before treating readings from this card as ground truth, per the same caution that applied to 15_rs485_soil.json before its scale correction.

measurands.name: temperature_c
measurands.accuracy: ±0.2 degC typical (Sensirion SHT40 datasheet; not yet confirmed against real hardware)

measurands.name: humidity_pct
measurands.accuracy: ±1.8 %RH typical (Sensirion SHT40 datasheet; not yet confirmed against real hardware)

failure_modes: CRC-8 mismatch on the I2C reply: a comms fault, not a physical reading -- sensor_ok cleared, last known-good value held rather than replaced with garbage
flat/stuck reading across a known environmental change: I2C bus fault or sensor lockup, power-cycle the board
humidity pinned at 0 or 100: condensation on the die, or the sensor pulled into an incompatible environment
mounting: free airflow around the sensor body; avoid self-heating from nearby components and direct sunlight
